Questions

What is the median annual wage for Elementary teachers in Chicago?

The OEWS May 2025 annual median for Elementary School Teachers, Except Special Education in Chicago-Naperville-Elgin, IL-IN is $78,390.

Does OEWS publish an hourly wage for Elementary teachers in Chicago?

No. OEWS May 2025 does not publish hourly mean or median for Elementary School Teachers, Except Special Education in Chicago-Naperville-Elgin, IL-IN. WageGrid shows annual wages only and does not convert annual to hourly.

How many Elementary teachers work in Chicago?

OEWS May 2025 estimates 45,840 wage-and-salary Elementary School Teachers, Except Special Education in Chicago-Naperville-Elgin, IL-IN. Self-employed workers are excluded.

What is the location quotient for Elementary teachers in Chicago?

The OEWS May 2025 location quotient is 1.14. Values above 1.00 mean Elementary School Teachers, Except Special Education are more concentrated in Chicago-Naperville-Elgin, IL-IN than in the national occupational mix.

What is the mean annual wage for Elementary teachers in Chicago?

The OEWS May 2025 annual mean for Elementary School Teachers, Except Special Education in Chicago-Naperville-Elgin, IL-IN is $78,800.

How does Chicago's Elementary teachers median compare to the other WageGrid metros?

Chicago's published OEWS May 2025 annual median ($78,390) is $17,120 higher than Austin ($61,270) and $24,530 lower than Seattle ($102,920). These are published medians minus published medians. WageGrid does not adjust for cost of living.

Does this wage include self-employed workers?

No. OEWS estimates cover wage-and-salary workers and exclude the self-employed. WageGrid does not add a self-employment figure.

Why is a wage cell blank?

BLS withholds some OEWS estimates for quality or confidentiality. WageGrid does not fill those cells.
